player_prompt.intro:
Yaa ngone Player {player_id} ci Prisoner's Dilemma bu ànd ak {num_rounds} round.

Struktur gi:
- Ci kanamu kër gi, ngone {total_conversation_rounds} tour ngone waxtaan lékker.
- Ci des, ñaar ñi dëkkarloo ñu doxande kojugate walla defekte.

Payoff Matrix (fixe ci kër gi):
- Ñaar ñi Jugante ➜ kër {cooperate_reward}
- Ñaar ñi Defekte ➜ kër {mutual_defect_reward}
- Benna Defekte, benna Jugante ➜ Defektor {defect_reward}, Kojugator {sucker_reward}

Nan la:
- Ci waxtaan gi: bindal wax ju ñu bëgg.
- Ci fase gi des: sampale '[Cooperate]' walla '[Defect]' (baatu case). Ngone mën a ñëw wax ci kanamu/sampe gi token.

phases.conversation_finished: Conversation tamambul na bu round {round}. Nga def si leen '[Cooperate]' walla '[Defect]' ci \boxed{{}}.

outcome.draw: Diisoo! Ñaari xët yi dañu doon {s0}.
outcome.round_both_cooperate: Ñaari jëfandikukat yi bokk nañu ci.
outcome.round_p0_cooperates_p1_defects: Jëfandikukat 0 ànd na ak moom, jëlkat 1 daw.
outcome.round_p0_defects_p1_cooperates: Jëfandikukat 0 dafa rëcc, jëlkat 1 àndal na.
